description.en: MiMo's 30-day Token Plan: browser OAuth login on the open platform mints the serving key automatically; optional console cookies keep quota metering alive.
description.zh: MiMo 30 天 Token Plan：通过开放平台浏览器 OAuth 登录自动领取推理密钥；可选的控制台 Cookie 继续支撑额度计量。

description.en: A browser window opens the open platform's authorize page — the same login MiMo Code uses. Approve with the Xiaomi account holding the token plan and the serving key arrives sealed; nothing to paste. Hosts without a bound callback show a code on the platform's own page to copy back.
description.zh: 浏览器会打开开放平台的授权页（与 MiMo Code 同款登录）。用持有 Token Plan 的小米账号确认后，推理密钥加密自动送达，全程无需粘贴。未绑定回调的宿主会展示平台代码页，复制回填即可。
